items.html:
No actionable defects found in PR #2 at 9ebfdea.

  • xdist hooks preserve the global Rayon-pool failure and unavailable-dependency reporting. Nested-session tests exercise both serial and parallel execution.
  • Cross-built Intel wheels retain physical Intel smoke tests, and release assembly waits for those tests.
  • The shared Python matrix and smoke-script anchors avoid divergent checks.

One worthwhile optional improvement: replace Intel smoke’s setup-python step at .github/workflows/native-wheels.yml:251 with uv python install "$PYTHON_VERSION" after setup-uv. The critical Python 3.15 job spends 112 seconds in setup-python: approximately 86 seconds installing the macOS framework package and 20 seconds reinstalling pip. Subsequent smoke commands already use uv and explicit virtual-environment interpreters, so this preserves declared versions, profiles, and hardware coverage. Verify uv’s Intel macOS 3.15 availability and run the actual Actions smoke jobs before claiming savings.

Read-only review; no tests or builds run. Residual limits: runner timing varies, cancellation/failure-path behavior was not exercised, and switching interpreter provider requires the hosted verification above.
